scope: Full migration chain; source grants ONLY, no simulated provider defaults
limitations: Local transaction rollback per CRUD probe, not hosted Supabase.
UPDATE probes write an unchanged nonkey value; they test UPDATE authorization and trigger execution, not every editable field value.
INSERT probes free the exact disposable fixture first inside the rolled-back owner transaction to avoid unique-constraint false positives.
